about: Dev acceptance evidence for #6621: use one ordinary local seat, remain seated for a minute, then get up. Native events and state are required. Rest recovery and visual collision still require separate acceptance. Never run automatically merely by adding this fixture.

steps.js: (function(){if(window.__ts5197home)return window.__ts5197home;var k=window.thornswoodSkills;if(!k||!k.isCreating)return '';var made=k.isCreating();if(made===null)return '';if(!made)return 'placed';var r=document.getElementById('ts-skills');if(!r||r.className==='gone')return '';var nav=[].slice.call(r.querySelectorAll('.nav .navrow'));function row(k){for(var i=0;i<nav.length;i++){var e=nav[i].querySelector('.k');if(e&&e.textContent===k)return nav[i];}return null;}var home=row('Starting Location'),review=row('Review');if(!home||!review)return '';var hv=home.querySelector('.v');if(hv&&/\bneed\b/.test(hv.className)){if(!/\bon\b/.test(home.className)){home.click();return '';}var cards=[].slice.call(r.querySelectorAll('.body .card'));var pick=null;for(var j=0;j<cards.length;j++){var n=cards[j].querySelector('.name');if(n&&/^Whiterun/.test(n.textContent)){pick=cards[j];break;}}if(!pick)pick=cards[0];if(pick)pick.click();return '';}if(!/\bon\b/.test(review.className)){review.click();return '';}var c=r.querySelector('[data-act="confirm"]');if(c&&!/\boff\b/.test(c.className)){c.click();window.__ts5197home='confirmed '+(hv?hv.textContent:'');return window.__ts5197home;}return '';})()
